title: Code and data for: Structure-preserving residual learning and predictive control of nonlinear descriptor power-network models
description: Python code, MATPOWER case9 and case39 input files, generated tables (CSV), figures and tests that reproduce all numerical results of the manuscript submitted to Communications in Nonlinear Science and Numerical Simulation.
